name: 23230 · Richmond, VA
findings: ZIP 23230 (Richmond) has 206 nonprofit organizations. 97 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 87 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 23230 (Richmond) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 23230 (Richmond) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 12.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 87 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.
